content:
Maya SRE: alerting — ap-south1 control plane 502/5xx surge since 02:26 UTC, lots of controller-manager restarts and failed CSI attaches. AlertBot: apiserver_5xx_rate > 5% :rotating_light:
Diego Infra: we did a network MTU change during the maintenance window at 01:50, rolling 9000 on the nodepools. Could a partial rollout cause this?
Priya Eng: checking logs, etcd peer latency spiked right at 02:25 and raft elections increased. sample from apiserver:
```
E0401 02:25:47.001 apiserver: read tcp 10.8.2.11:6443->10.8.2.33:52711: i/o timeout
E0401 02:25:47.005 etcd: grpc: the client connection is closing
```
Jon Ops: also seeing AttachVolume timeout errors in controller-manager around the same time: `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded` and kubelet detach timeouts.
Maya SRE: that maps to fragmented KV packets causing retransmits. Are any nodes showing MTU=1500 still?
Diego Infra: yes — two faulty hosts in rtx-pool didn't get the new config due to a tag mismatch in the CM job. Rolling fix now.
Priya Eng: temporary mitigation: reduce `--concurrent-attaches` on controller-manager from 20->5 and increase reconcile period to 3m to avoid thundering retries. Canary to 1 replica first.
Jon Ops: can we also route non-consistent read traffic to eu-west1 fallback to reduce local etcd load while we remediate?
Maya SRE: agreed for non-leader reads. Diego, coordinate with network to add fallback route.
Diego Infra: MTU remediation applied to the 2 nodes. Running `ip link` and `ping -M dont -s 8972` checks.
AlertBot: [incident] INC-2026-2301 created, severity=high, owner=Diego Infra, notify=#oncall.
Priya Eng: canary patch rolled, leader-election jitter dropped within 60s, apiserver 5xx trending down.
Maya SRE: monitor for 30m. Action items: 1) finish MTU verification across region (Diego), 2) roll controller-manager safe defaults globally (Priya), 3) cost impact + billing note (Jon).
Jon Ops: preliminary billing hit ~420 USD for retry/attach ops during spike window, adding to incident notes for finance.
Diego Infra: MTU verified on region, all nodes report 9000. Network logs show BGP flaps at 02:24 that coincided with the partial rollout — adding to timeline.
Maya SRE: status update: apiserver 5xx back to baseline at 02:34, controller-manager restarts stopped. Leaving canary for 10m then roll. Drafting postmortem: root cause = partial MTU misconfig + transient BGP flap -> etcd heartbeat fragmentation -> control plane instability -> attach thrash.
Priya Eng: will include remediation: preflight tag checks, safer controller-manager defaults, and an MTU verification job post-rollout.
Maya SRE: thanks team. If it reappears ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
